_instructions: Use this pack to make your own word list. In the Word List panel, paste or type one item per line in this format: question | answer | hint. The question part is required; answer and hint are optional. Example line: apple | 苹果 | a round red fruit. A line with only a question works too: apple. Save your list to keep it in this pack.
description: An empty pack for your own words. Paste a list in the Word List panel and this pack fills up automatically.
name: Blank / Custom
